purpose: Teach: 粉末/芳香/ソーラー/バカンス/渓谷/チャーハン/半袖/しょうゆ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがお薬を粉末にして下さったぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father had medicine ground into powder for me.
lines.style: Nostalgic, reaching back. Slow, deliberate pace. Soft voice — not sad, but tender with distance. The 「ぞ」ending lands quietly, almost to himself.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、お庭の花の芳香を楽しまれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and Grandfather, you enjoyed the scent of the garden flowers, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, gently steering. A light touch of teasing affection — she knows where his mind goes. Voice soft but present, bringing him back to shared memory. The question rises slightly at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがソーラー時計を珍しがられたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father thought a solar-powered watch was quite something special.
lines.style: Tender distance again. Slower pace. The memory surfaces — something small, something he noticed. Voice trails slightly, as if he's picturing it. Quiet wonder underneath.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、夏にバカンスで温泉に行かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandfather, and you took summer vacations to the hot springs, didn't you?
lines.style: Knowing warmth. She's redirecting again with gentle humor — the affection of someone who knows his patterns. Light, almost teasing. Voice stays warm and grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと渓谷の旅館に泊まったぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father and I stayed at an inn in the valley.
lines.style: Voice softens further. This memory is closer, more precious. Slow breath. The 「ぞ」 lands like he's offering it to her — not commanding, sharing. A small vulnerability in the wistfulness.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様にチャーハンを作って下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandfather, you made fried rice for the grandchildren, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, direct affection now. She's bringing him into the present, into what he gave. Voice is steady, proud — celebrating him gently. Slight smile in the tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが夏は半袖を好まれたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father preferred short sleeves in the summer.
lines.style: Quieter still. Almost whispering the past. Each word deliberate, held. The distance of decades. Voice thin but steady — a small detail that mattered.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、しょうゆの味付けをこだわってらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandfather, you were particular about the soy sauce seasoning, weren't you?
lines.style: Close, intimate. Final turn — she's bringing him fully into the now, into who he was. Warm exhale. The affection is clearest here. Trailing softly, like a benediction.
